options.text: I have come to seek a blessing.

steps.player: I have come to seek a blessing.

steps.text: If the player has an unholy symbol in their inventory:

steps.npc: I see you have the unholy symbol of our Lord. It is blessed with the Lord Zamorak's power.
Come to me when your faith weakens.

steps.text: If the player has an unpowered symbol in their inventory:

steps.npc: I see you have the unholy symbol of our Lord. I will bless it for you.

steps.text: The ghost mutters in a strange voice.
The unholy symbol throbs with power.

steps.npc: The symbol of our Lord has been blessed with power!

steps.text: If the player has neither of the above in their inventory:

steps.npc: No blessings will be given to those who have no symbol of our Lord's love.

options.text: I need another unholy symbol mould.

steps.player: I need another mould for the unholy symbol.

steps.text: If the player does not have an unholy mould:

steps.npc: To lose an object is easy to replace. To lose the affections of our Lord is impossible to forgive.

steps.text: The ghost hands you another mould.
If the player already has an unholy mould:

steps.npc: One you already have, another is not needed.

options.text: I have come to kill you.

steps.npc: Indeed, I feel you have beheld the far places in the heavens.
My Lord instructs me to help you.
Here is a mould to make a token for our Lord; a mould for the unholy symbol of Zamorak.

steps.text: The ghost gives you a casting mould.

options.text: I have come to kill you.

wC-j6J.player: I have come to kill you.

wC-j6J.npc: The might of mortals, to me, is as the dust to the sea.
